
# Success Indicators

## Year 1

* First tranche workflows delivered.
* At least one workflow demonstrated on EcoCommons.
* Initial training materials available.
* FAIR implementation plans completed.
* User testing completed.

## Year 2

* Workflow catalogue operational.
* Dashboard operational.
* PID implementation completed.
* FAIR workflow publication completed.
* Expanded ecosystem coverage.

## Beyond Project

* Additional workflows contributed by community members.
* Evidence of reuse in ecosystem reporting and management.
* Adoption by government, research and environmental management organisations.
